items.title: Dave Frishberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: And my specialty was with Al Cohn and Zoot Sims. That was the band I felt at home with. I spent eight years with them.

ctx.x: It’s one gig after another, I mean what do you want? Each one of them, they all had their own stories. I guess the gig I think of the most as my golden age of New York playing was the one at the Half Note, which I held, along with other piano players, Ross Tompkins and Roger Kellaway and I maybe, were the three players that were used as house players. We were the utility guys. So we got to play with a lot of great players. And my specialty was with Al Cohn and Zoot Sims. That was the band I felt at home with. I…
They were a great match, weren’t they?
